isolated.reason: Using agree as a lexical verb to state agreement is distinct from marking continuing duration, calibrating polite favors, and expressing past regret. A shared be form does not establish the same underlying production ability.
Observation review is unresolved; retain isolated evidence.

isolated.dimension: Time reference appropriate to the speaker's English variety
isolated.reason: The legitimate British English at-the-weekend wording provides a distinct positive occurrence of time reference. It does not evidence the past-to-present duration ability or uncertainty or requesting tone, and should not be converted into a difficulty.

isolated.dimension: Expressing advice with the verb suggest
isolated.reason: The observation concerns complement selection after suggest when reporting advice. Past-to-present duration, regret availability and interpersonal request tone are separate abilities; advice and requests being socially related does not justify grouping this verb-specific syntax with request tone.

isolated.dimension: Expressing advice with the verb suggest
isolated.reason: Both use suggest followed by a person object and infinitive to report an advised action. Wait and leave change the action content, not the suggest complement ability. The matching score is not the basis of this semantic decision.

isolated.dimension: Expressing advice with the verb suggest
isolated.reason: The new utterance repeats the same suggest person-object infinitive structure as both group members. Changing who gave advice or which action was proposed does not change the complement-selection dimension. Concentration on one date does not itself establish a longitudinal pattern.

isolated.dimension: Describing transport of a physical object
isolated.reason: Legitimate take for transporting furniture evidences a distinct physical-transport expression. None of the retrieved duration, time-reference or regret groups addresses that ability. A shared verb with other uses would not establish shared pedagogical membership.

The utterance expresses uncertainty, but this observation explicitly concerns unprompted self-repair rather than initial natural formulation. Repair is a related but distinct production dimension; uncertain self-correction must not be counted as two attempts or as a straightforward success/failure of the established group.

isolated.dimension: Explaining causal reasons with a subordinating connector
isolated.reason: Since introduces a causal reason here, not a past starting point for an ongoing state. The temporal candidate shares a connector superficially but concerns a different production ability; price emphasis and request tone are also distinct. This legitimate causal clause is positive isolated evidence.
